claim: ZenoEnergy pairwise training can weight every verifier-accepted tied maximum-objective candidate as a positive example, avoiding extra pressure toward the arbitrary hash-selected representative.

training_rule.hash_winner: winner_pair_weight applies only when label.is_winner is true.
training_rule.objective_equivalent: winner_pair_weight applies to every valid candidate whose (objective_volume, objective_surplus) equals the best valid objective in the batch.
training_rule.tie_pairs: Pairs with equal validity, volume, and surplus remain skipped by the pairwise ordering loss.

limits: This receipt proves training-target hygiene, not a new benchmark improvement.
The legacy hash-winner mode remains available for reproducing older model artifacts.
Objective-equivalent training still uses synthetic verifier-labeled candidates unless paired with a real replay or shadow dataset.
